chapter: Spirits of Rhythm and the road in the 1930s
title: Collectors, old records and the Bihari brothers' studio
summary: They talk about collectors holding old Lang recordings, and Bunn says he made many records for Jules Bihari's small studio in Glendale.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
